answer: Each submission hangs on the zenith of a task receipt, and the ripple is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the velvet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
